title: Store Settings & Configuration
description: Learn how to configure store settings including contact information, social media links, and store preferences.
content:
Store Settings & Configuration

Store settings allow you to customize your store's behavior, appearance, and functionality. This guide covers all available settings.

Accessing Store Settings

To access store settings:

  1. Navigate to Stores in the sidebar
  2. Click on your store
  3. Go to the Settings tab

General Settings

Store Information

  • Store Name: Display name of your store
  • Store Slug: URL-friendly identifier
  • Description: Brief description of your store
  • Logo: Store logo image
  • Favicon: Browser tab icon

Contact Information

  • Email: Contact email address
  • Phone: Contact phone number
  • Address: Physical store address
  • Country/State/City: Location details

Social Media Links

Add links to your social media profiles:

  • Facebook
  • Twitter
  • Instagram
  • LinkedIn
  • YouTube
  • Pinterest

Store Status

Control your store's availability:

  • Active: Store is live and accessible
  • Inactive: Store is hidden from public
  • Maintenance Mode: Show maintenance message to visitors

Maintenance Mode

When enabled, visitors see a maintenance message instead of your store. This is useful for:

  • Site updates
  • Major changes
  • Temporary closures

Store admins can still access the store during maintenance.

Store Preferences

Currency

Set your store's default currency. This affects:

  • Product prices
  • Order totals
  • Payment processing

Language

Set the default language for your store. You can enable multiple languages for international customers.

Time Zone

Set your store's timezone for accurate order timestamps and reporting.

SEO Settings

Optimize your store for search engines:

  • Meta Title: Page title for search results
  • Meta Description: Description shown in search results
  • Keywords: Relevant keywords for SEO

Store Analytics

Configure analytics tracking:

  • Google Analytics ID
  • Facebook Pixel ID
  • Other tracking codes

Legal Pages

Link to your legal pages:

  • Privacy Policy
  • Terms of Service
  • Refund Policy
  • Shipping Policy

Saving Changes

After making changes:

  1. Review all settings
  2. Click Save button
  3. Wait for confirmation

Changes take effect immediately.

Next Steps

After configuring settings, you may want to:

  • Customize your store theme
  • Manage store content
